name: myband
description: MyBand.video - music intelligence platform (BPM, key, chords, MIDI, song sections).

scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn app.main:app --reload --app-dir apps/api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.worker:api: uv run --project apps/api --group worker --directory apps/api python -m app.workers
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check --config apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api
scripts.format:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff format --config apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api
